desc:
Old School Night Watchman 

The first night as an old school guard should be a simple job. Maintaining security, checking every room, and ensuring everything stays safe until morning.

But when the clock struck 11 PM, everything started to change.

The school phone suddenly rings by itself. The locked doors begin to open. The sound of footsteps is heard from the empty hallway. And slowly, you realize that something is in the school with you.

Every hour brings new tasks and deeper mysteries. You must explore dark rooms, search for needed items, complete various tasks, and uncover the dark secrets hidden behind this old school.

But as the night goes on, it becomes clear that you're not the only one walking around the school.

Hold on until 5 a.m.

Complete all tasks.
Discover the secrets of the school.
